fn gcd(x: Int, y: Int) -> Int
  requires (x > 0)
  requires (y > 0)
  ensures (result == (if (x == y) then x else if (x > y) then gcd((x - y), y) else gcd(x, (y - x))))
  effects pure
  example (gcd(1, 1) == 1)
  example (gcd(2, 2) == 2)
{
  if (x == y) then x else if (x > y) then gcd((x - y), y) else gcd(x, (y - x))
}

fn gcdI(m: Int, n: Int) -> Int
  requires (m > 0)
  requires (n > 0)
  ensures (result == gcd(m, n))
  effects pure
  example (gcdI(0, 0) == 0)
{
  0
}
